'''Shadow Brutes (dangerous)''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. 150 void spirits (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
They behave identical to their weaker counterpart, the [[Shadow Brute]]. They have no special attacks, but resist {{Name|Weight|class=inline|link=Weight{{!}}knockback}}.

==Strategy==
Attack them, backing away when they get close.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
